title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1516: Found you! (3)

section.p: Outside.
The mansion had been open for nineteen days.
It would remain open for eleven more days.
Not a single tunnel remained. Nobody knew if the tunnel would reappear. How many survivors were left inside?

Suddenly, someone broke the silence with a sigh and said, “We wait. A lot of names are still on the Heavenly Hunt Index. If the Heavenly Hunt Index isn’t broken, these people are probably still alive. Mo Duona, Zhan Wushuang, Endless Passage, September, Skyeater…these people are still on their respective rankings.”

It was worth noting that Heavencurse’s name had vanished. He might have died. The celestial chasm experts could only sigh with regret at that. As for Spiritvenge, his tunnel had long snapped. He might have died as well. One could say that the celestial chasm race had suffered massively from this opening.
Meanwhile, the immortals appeared calm and indifferent. However, everyone knew that they were not that calm. After all, more and more immortal kings had been arriving during the past few days.

Clearly, they were unhappy with the results this time. They might try something when the survivors left the mansion. It wasn’t like they had anything to lose since they had lost all their people in the mansion.

As for the humans, their Invincibles had also been arriving in recent days. Or to be precise, this was happening with all the major races. The number of Invincibles gathered outside the mansion had surpassed the previous number.
“Are there still no news from inside the mansion?”
“The mansion has calmed down. It has been a while since any message arrived from the inside.”
“Is anyone’s descendant still alive? Can someone contact their descendant to find out what’s going on? We can pay the cost of the message.”
Everyone was anxious about the situation inside the mansion.
Someone looked at the devils and said, “Devil King Moge, why don’t you try contacting Mo Duona? His name is still on the index. He’s probably still alive…”
Moge frowned and said, “He’s not the only one alive. Zhan Wushuang, Endless Passage, September, and the others are alive as well. Great Xia King can also try contacting Xia Longwu.”
Great Xia King said, “Is there a point? It’s not like any of you trust me.”

True. It would be better for a few of them to make the attempt to learn more about what was happening inside. However, none of the Invincibles were willing to waste their blood essence for this. That could very well cause their deaths later.
After a short silence, Great Xia King sent a voice transmission, “I still think we need to ask. I’ll try asking Longwu…”
“I’ll do it.” Great Zhou King replied, “I’ll ask Tianfang.”
Yes. Zhu Tianfang. This Great Zhou King did not resemble the real Great Zhou King. Or perhaps…was Zhu Tianfang actually a child of the Zhou Family?

Great Xia King appeared unsurprised. He said, “Sure. After igniting your blood essence, nobody will suspect you when we start fighting later even if you look weaker than normal. Otherwise, they might see through you easily.”
“What are you saying? Are you saying that I’m weaker than Old Zhou?”
As he said that, Great Zhou King glanced at Great Xia King with profound eyes.
Great Xia King replied without a change in expression, “You know the answer. Look at that spear of his earlier. Can you compete against that?”
“Heh. You never know.”

Great Xia King couldn’t be bothered to keep arguing. Yes. The current Great Zhou King was actually Great Ming King in disguise. The real Great Zhou King was guarding the Eastrift Valley. As for Great Qin King, he had entered the mansion disguised as Great Ming King.

With such an arrangement, they had been able to create an illusion that Great Qin King was still guarding the Eastrift Valley. The greatest goal of humanity this time was Great Qin King’s advancement. But so far, things were not looking good.
Great Zhou King, no, Great Ming King said nothing else as well. He looked at the Luminous Domain Mansion again and frowned. What role would the kid play in the changes this time?

He sat down cross-legged and ignited his blood essence to contact Zhu Tianfang. Nobody disturbed him. Everyone watched curiously. Clearly, even the humans were growing anxious as well. Was Great Zhou King trying to contact Zhou Polong?
Before long, a connection was established.
Great Ming King appeared inside a unique domain.
Next, Zhu Tianfang’s silhouette appeared before him. He went straight to the point, “How’s Old Qin?”
“Heavily injured. He lost two bodies.”
Great Ming King was greatly shaken. He asked, “How about the others?”
“Xia Longwu and Qin Zhen are heavily injured. Both are recuperating. I’m fine. Also…”
“What?”
“Su Yu is here. He’s crazy. He killed numerous experts…”
“Be careful. Watch out when you’re leaving. The tunnels have collapsed. You might not be able to leave the normal way.”
Then, Great Ming King exited the unique domain with a slightly pale expression. This was not due to his exhaustion alone. News of Great Qin King had also contributed to that.
This was troublesome.
When Great Xia King looked at him, he smiled and nodded. But he changed his expression in a split second and said sadly, “It’s over. We suffered disastrous losses. It’s terrible…”
The myriad race experts rolled their eyes.
Bullshit!

The humans had suffered the least this opening. Nobody would be stupid enough to trust his words. Damn that lying bastard. Just look at that hypocritical face of his. Then, Great Ming King flashed everyone a gentle smile.

At the same time, he sent Great Xia King a voice transmission, “Be ready. Something happened to Old Qin. He lost two bodies. The moment he’s out, escort him back. Don’t let anyone notice anything. Only the two of us will know about this. At most, we’ll let Old Zhou know as well. Nobody else can know.”
Great Xia King’s heart thumped. The worst had still happened.
“How about the skylotus? If we have it, either Old Zhou or me can use it and achieve Daofuse. With Old Qin alive, we should still be able to keep the others in check…”
“I didn’t have the chance to ask, but they have probably failed to get it.”
Great Xia King’s mood sank. Things were looking really bad.

Great Ming King continued, “Also, Su Yu is inside. He killed many people. He might be the reason for all the changes this time. I didn’t get the chance to ask more. It won’t be easy for him to return to his ancient city after leaving the mansion. It’s a short journey, but we need to consider escorting him as well. Do we help him?”
“Yes.”
“But…”
Great Ming King said, “Old Qin requires our help as well. Do we have enough people to escort both of them?”

Great Xia King sank into a long silence. Finally, he said, “We gave up on the multiple character faction once. Are we doing that again? If we must, gather all our Eternals here. Trigger a battle while Old Qin and the rest of us are still alive. Fight the myriad races to the death. This will be enough to deter many of them.”

“We’ll make our final decision when Old Qin is out. Also, Old Zhou better keep his disguise up or things might get troublesome. If Old Qin were to die, just claim that it was me. I’ll keep my disguise as Old Zhou. Old Zhou can keep pretending to be Old Qin. We need to keep the act up.”

Losing Great Ming King would shake the human race, but humanity would persevere. Losing Great Qin King would bring about a completely different effect. Thus, they could lose Great Ming King, but Great Qin King must continue existing.

Great Xia King did not argue. That was their sole option. Old Zhou might be strong, but he was still not enough to replace Great Qin King’s position. In fact, even Great Xia King himself would not be willing to convince himself to follow Great Zhou King.
The two human kings started standing there in silence with deep worry in their hearts. However, they had to keep appearing indifferent.
On the eighth level.

Su Yu and Lan Tian were following Blood Fire’s trail. Even when encountering large and interesting residences, they did not bother to investigate. Their priority was Blood Fire Devil King, not the treasures here.
In terms of searching for people, the little furball was a lot more useful than the two of them. His sense of smell toward characters or perhaps willpower was incredibly sensitive.
Su Yu and Lan Tian were not capable of this.
After a while, the little furball wrinkled his nose and said, “In front. That big house…”
Su Yu looked over and his eyes flickered.
“Bloodmount General’s Residence.”
Su Yu looked around, unsure if this was the residence of a titled or untitled general.
In any case, Blood Fire Devil King was inside.
“Found you!”
After shooting each other a glance, Su Yu and Lan Tian vanished with a flicker.
Inside the residence, Blood Fire Devil King’s face sank. Danger.
His pursuers were here.
Damn it! He only hoped that they wouldn’t find him. Since there were so many residences here, it was unlikely that they could find him so easily.
“Bloodmount General…”
There were records of the Bloodmount General among the blood fire devils. He looked around, hoping that he could find something useful to recover some of his strength from the residence.
